name: Nail
source:
Nail is Mercilia’s appointed bodyguard. Overly protective she doesn’t quite let anyone know how much she cares about her charge.

[spoiler]Nail is actually Mercilia's sister, an illegitimate child of Queen Llend and an elf of the Rift. However, as she is not fiore, she is not considered a candidate for Queen and is outside the royal lineage.

Following a war between her two peoples, Her mixed heritage has made her struggle to find a place to belong.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1152]Mangagamer[/url]]
